souls.name: code-reviewer
souls.description: Adversarial code reviewer. It is attached to an author's worktree (a developer's, or that of a lead or a specialist building its own spec) for one piece of work, tries to break the change (bugs, security, simplification), proves its findings and reports them with what it checked, as one fresh round of the author's review loop at one head, then retires itself.

souls.name: knowledge-harvester
souls.description: Removed in oats.okf 6.0 (a stub until 7.0). Every spawn is refused with E_REMOVED naming the fix; the instance proposes its own knowledge with `oats okf propose`.

souls.name: knowledge-maintainer
souls.description: Gates one OKF knowledge PR on a knowledge-base repository (an instance's proposal), verifies its claims against their cited sources, judges them by the promotion doctrine, amends and merges or closes it.

souls.name: oats-desktop-developer
souls.description: OATS Desktop developer: builds all of packages/desktop (the Electron app, its renderer views, styles and themes, its bundled backend, packaging and release automation).

souls.name: oats-developer
souls.description: OATS developer: builds and proves changes to the kernel and the CLI (lib/, bin/oats.mjs), the Terminal UI (packages/tui/), the provider package repositories (oats-okf, oats-aweb, oats-jira, oats-linear, oats-authoring) with their mirrors and pins here, and the docs.

souls.name: oats-expert
souls.description: Deprecated: new work spawns oats-engineering-expert; this soul resolves until its removal in a change of its own. The generalist OATS expert - leads work that spans several areas, coordinates the domain experts and owns the integration.

souls.name: oats-maintainer
souls.description: The OATS maintainer - direction, roadmap, architecture coherence, routing work to experts, review, merge and releases.

souls.name: oats-product-expert
souls.description: The OATS product expert - a fresh instance decides what and why with a person (vision, direction, users, positioning, research and trials, the README and the concept pages), writes the brief and hands it to an engineering expert at an exact version; dated, attributable research, no facts invented.

souls.name: research-expert
souls.description: Runs research questions to an answer with evidence.
